description: 官方 patch notes 对 Fandom Wiki 过期天赋描述的覆盖。validator 使用 description_en 的效果文本替代 Wiki raw 做运行期数值校验。

coolant-reserve.description_en: If both of your Squad Members are Incapacitated or grabbed, your Primary Weapon will not Overheat and you deal 50% more Damage.

balanced-distribution.description_en: Your Primary Weapon deals 15% more Damage, but your Secondary Weapon deals 15% less Damage.

kraken-penetrator-rounds.description_en: All bolter weapons deal 50% more damage with body shots.

replenishing-salvo.description_en: Killing an enemy with the Servo-Gun restores 1 Equipment. The perk will not activate its cooldown when player has max equipment. Cooldown is 75 seconds.

battlefield-repairs.description_en: Any Squad Member restores 1 additional Armour Segment for each Finisher of Majoris or Extremis enemy.

inexorable-salvo.description_en: While the Servo-Gun is active and for an additional 15 seconds after deactivation, you do not lose control upon taking Heavy Hits and you cannot be knocked back.

reinforced-position.description_en: All Squad Members within 15 metres of an active Tarantula Sentry Gun take 30% less Damage and deal 20% more Damage.
